newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM raises palladium daily price limits.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM raises palladium daily price limits.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Monday it raised the daily price limit of palladium futures to 24 yen per gram from 22 yen after the average price of palladium futures rose to 609.1 yen on Friday.

The exchange said the daily price limit of palladium futures is set at 24 yen per gram when the average price is above 600 yen, while the price limit is set at 22 yen when the average price is in a range of 400 yen and 600 yen.
